ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels on distal lobes and 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels in the median and boundary regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous white fields on both lobes tapering toward the median; right lobe shows dense dark stippling and mottling at the transition zone; center median is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 55 degrees; lower vertex is partially occluded by white water foam pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations along both lobes; right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher amplitude variations (peaks) compared to the more uniform micro-serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve leading to acute, slightly upward-tapering lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity white clusters visible along the dark trailing edge of the left lobe; small dark focal points observed on the white distal field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of three parallel, low-intensity (black) linear streaks oriented horizontally on the white field of the right lobe (rake marks).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark horizontal rake scarring on the right lobe; several irregular indentations/nicks present along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark crescent-shaped mark located in the upper-distal region of the right lobe's white pigmentation field.
